spec.title: PROP-019: Organization consumer licensing and distribution evidence

status.comment: trusted policy data foundation; consumer scanning and artifact enforcement remain open

p.ORGANIZATION-POLICY-FORMAT: codkitOrganizationPolicy:1 declares organization profile ID/revision, own holders and license expression, approved/forbidden third-party expressions, approved exceptions, a LicenseRef namespace, exact canonical custom-license texts with SHA-256, distribution notice/SBOM/carrier requirements and optional legal-review reference. The schema is strict and types derive from it. SPDX identifiers come from the installed list. NOASSERTION, undeclared/foreign-namespace LicenseRef and missing/changed text/hash refuse. Custom texts are LF-only with a final LF and no BOM. This profile applies to consumer scope and never weakens Codkit's separate installed supply policy.

p.ORGANIZATION-POLICY-TRUST: A user/admin composition root supplies the policy directory; the default is the user .codkit directory. organization-policies.json carries codkitOrganizationPolicyStore:1 and policy records. Store reads use contained regular-file I/O, validate every profile and refuse conflicting IDs including case aliases. A directory inside the physical patchset or an alias resolving into it refuses. No cwd/patchset fallback or patchset-supplied policy path is accepted. The selected policy and raw store bytes each receive their own digest; a digest is not an invented signature or legal approval.

p.ORGANIZATION-POLICY-SELECTION: Patchset selection contains only profile ID and optional additionalForbidden expressions. Holders, allowlists, license text, policy locations and other authority fields refuse. Additional prohibitions are monotone and cannot enable a license. Own scope uses the exact declared own expression; third-party scope uses exact approved expression combinations and forbidden identifiers/expressions. AND/OR/WITH and bounded parentheses are syntax, never automatic inference of legal permissions; an OR combination not explicitly approved remains refused.

p.ORGANIZATION-DISTRIBUTION-EVIDENCE: Consumer source scanning, actual artifact NOTICE/carrier checks and selected SBOM export must bind the selected trusted policy before package/publish enforcement is accepted. A minified artifact without required attached notice is incomplete/red even when source headers were valid. Report evidence complete/incomplete, never a legal-compatibility ruling. Mechanism fixtures are labelled examples, not real commercial approvals or external partner evidence.
